completed_steps.summary: Classified repository as a monorepo with four product parts: landing, website, backend, and mobile suite.
Inventoried existing README files, deployment metadata, and landing page smoke test assets.
Detected Angular 21 website, ASP.NET backend with Cosmos DB and SignalR, static landing site, and Flutter mobile apps with a shared package.
Performed deep scan of key source files for routing, auth, services, entities, API controllers, mobile entry points, and deployment configuration.
Generated annotated source tree summary for all major product surfaces.
Wrote project overview, per-part architecture guides, development guides, component inventory, API contracts, data models, deployment guide, and integration documentation.
Generated master documentation index and project parts metadata.
Validated generated documentation set and finalized initial scan.

technology_stack.landing: Static HTML, CSS, JS marketing site
technology_stack.website: Angular 21 dashboard using AngularFire compat and Material/CDK
technology_stack.backend: ASP.NET Core Web API using Autofac, Firebase Admin, Cosmos DB, SignalR, Azure Blob Storage
technology_stack.mobile-suite: Flutter apps with shared package, Firebase Core/Auth, Provider, HTTP, SignalR client

risks: Production-like secrets and service credentials are committed in repository config files.
Deployment URLs differ across landing page, guest web, and dashboard surfaces, which raises environment drift risk.
Shared domain models are duplicated across backend and Flutter shared package, so schema drift is possible.

resume_instructions: Initial deep scan completed. Resume from specific doc refinement if needed.
